name: Sally King
prior_offices: Albany County coroner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Sally King is the Albany County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official coroner page lists her in that office and describes the statutory duty to investigate unattended, violent, accidental, and other specified deaths under Title 7, Chapter 4 of Wyoming statutes. The Laramie Reporter reported that she, a Democrat, received 58% of the vote and defeated Republican Ryan Hershey (7,257 votes to 5,311).
